The '''Luudria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Luudrian lockjaw]]s<ref name="WretchedHives" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> and also shared its name with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Luudrian Star]]''.<ref name="BigQuince">{{JournalCite|2|Big Quince (short story)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Luudria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
